sources.title: Kimi-K2-Thinking model card
sources.evidence: Exact Thinking checkpoint: 1T total parameters, 32B activated, MoE, MLA, 61 layers, 384 routed experts, eight selected experts and one shared expert. Documents 256K context, public weights, text chat, reasoning_content, and native function calling.

sources.title: Introducing Kimi K2 Thinking
sources.evidence: Original Thinking announcement describes stepwise reasoning interleaved with tool calls for agentic search, coding and writing. Quantization-aware post-training applies INT4 weight-only quantization to MoE components. Its evaluation footnotes explicitly identify 256k as the context limit.

sources.title: Kimi Research Blog release index
sources.evidence: The Kimi K2 Thinking announcement is dated 2025-11-06, separately from July K2, September K2-Instruct-0905 and January K2.5.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Thinking checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: model_type kimi_k2; DeepseekV3ForCausalLM; 61 layers, 384 routed experts, eight experts per token, one shared expert; max_position_embeddings 262144 and YaRN factor 64 from 4096. Uses compressed-tensors packed INT4 routed-expert weights, with listed exclusions.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Thinking Modified MIT License
sources.evidence: Copyright 2025 Moonshot AI. MIT permission and notice terms plus a condition requiring prominent Kimi K2 UI attribution for commercial products/services exceeding 100 million monthly active users or USD 20 million monthly revenue. This is an attribution condition, not a prohibition on larger commercial use.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Thinking transformer implementation
sources.evidence: DeepseekV3Model implements a Transformer decoder; decoder blocks combine self-attention with dense/MoE feed-forward modules, and DeepseekV3ForCausalLM produces token logits through an LM head.

sources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence, revised technical report
sources.evidence: Inspected the February 2026 revision of the July K2 report. It describes original K2; the accessed HTML contains no K2 Thinking mention. Its specifications are not used as Thinking-specific evidence.

sources.title: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
sources.evidence: Later first-party report explicitly describes K2 Thinking as an earlier tool-using reasoning model and studies its token-efficient RL behavior in Figure 5. K2.5 architecture, vision inputs and counts are not transferred to this checkpoint.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.5 later model card
sources.evidence: Later card explicitly links its native INT4 method and interleaved reasoning/tool-call design to K2 Thinking. Its parameter table describes K2.5, so it supplies no replacement count for the exact Thinking checkpoint.

developer.note: Checkpoint publisher and license copyright identify Moonshot AI.

family.note: Normalize to Kimi K2: the card explicitly starts from Kimi K2 and the checkpoint model_type is kimi_k2; Thinking is the variant.

release_date.note: Developer release index dates the announcement; this is the original public release, not a provider rollout.

open_weights.note: Developer distributes the checkpoint and grants model-weight use under its published license.

license.note: MIT-derived terms require prominent Kimi K2 UI attribution above either 100 million monthly active users or USD 20 million monthly revenue for a commercial product/service.

parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-reported 1T total, expressed in billions. Not an exact tensor census; quantization scales and packed-storage elements were not counted.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-reported 32B activated parameters; retained at its published precision.

architecture.note: Decoder-only MoE Transformer with MLA; exact checkpoint config and implementation corroborate the model card.

context_window.note: Release evaluation specifies a supported 256K context limit; the matching checkpoint maximum is 262144 positions. The config corroborates the supported limit, rather than independently establishing it.

modalities.note: Text generation checkpoint and documented text chat; code is token-input causal LM with no vision/audio encoder.

reasoning.note: Original announcement explicitly describes stepwise reasoning, and the later report identifies this exact model as a reasoning baseline.

tool_call.note: Native function calling is documented with tool schemas, tool_calls responses and interleaved reasoning; execution requires an external tool runtime.

description.value: Open-weight Kimi K2 reasoning model with a mixture-of-experts Transformer, MLA attention, and native tool calling for multi-step research, coding, and writing.
description.note: Replaces vague speed/use-case copy with supported architecture and capabilities; does not claim present-day API availability.

patch.description: Open-weight Kimi K2 reasoning model with a mixture-of-experts Transformer, MLA attention, and native tool calling for multi-step research, coding, and writing.
patch.notes: 1T total and 32B activated are nominal developer counts, not exact counts of stored tensors. This is a decoder-only MoE Transformer with MLA and a supported 256K (262,144-token) context. Modified MIT requires prominent Kimi K2 UI attribution for commercial products/services above 100 million monthly active users or USD 20 million monthly revenue. This describes the released checkpoint and does not assert that its original API endpoint remains operational.

summary: All 14 fields verified for the exact Kimi K2 Thinking checkpoint. Add nominal 1000B total/32B activated parameters, MoE architecture and Modified MIT license; normalize family to kimi-k2 and replace unsupported relative-speed description. Confirm original 2025-11-06 release, 262144-token supported context, public weights, text modalities, reasoning and native tools. Exact checkpoint card/config are decisive; July K2 and later K2.5 specifications were not transferred.
